name: live-run-monitoring-via-state-poll-plus-stream-tail
description: Monitoring a live K8s run: GET /runs/:id/events tails the live stream and never closes (a full download only completes at terminal), so poll run state via GET /runs/:id every ~55s and, to check progress, background-download the event stream to a file and inspect its tail — event ts freshness proves the agent is alive.
